# Sample Studio — Internal Pricing Guide (synthetic test fixture, not Aangan's figures)

## Residential

| Project type | Indicative range |
| :---- | :---- |
| Standard specification | ₹1,000 – ₹2,000 per sq ft |
| Premium specification | ₹2,000 – ₹3,000 per sq ft |

Single room redesign (all-in): ₹2 lakh – ₹6 lakh depending on room size and specification.

## Commercial (office / clinic / studio)

| Project type | Indicative range |
| :---- | :---- |
| Basic fitout | ₹800 – ₹1,200 per sq ft |
| Mid-range office | ₹1,200 – ₹2,000 per sq ft |
